docket_entries.description: NOTICE OF MOTION TO STAY (TRANSACTION ID # 76868163) FILED BY DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO HEARING SET FOR SEP-05-2025 AT 09:00 AM IN DEPT 301
MINI MINUTES FOR SEP-05-25 09:00 AM FOR DEPT 301

LAW & MOTION/DISCOVERY, DEPT. 301, AS TO SEP-05-2025 HEARING RE: DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO'S MOTION TO STAY; THE COURT ADOPTS ITS TENTATIVE RULING. THE UNOPPOSED MOTION TO STAY THIS ACTION PENDING RESOLUTION OF FEDERAL CASES CHALLENGING THE CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO'S COVID-19 VACCINE POLICY IS GRANTED. (SEE MINI MINUTES FOR COMPLETE RULING.) COUNSEL FOR THE PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE AND SUBMIT A PROPOSED ORDER WHICH REPEATS VERBATIM THE SUBSTANTIVE PORTION OF THE COURT'S RULING. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: V. DA FONSECA; NOT REPORTED. (301/CVA)
